clusters.title: Multiple choice: the page CIRCLES a letter for a negated stem ('which is false', 'is NOT a', 'does NOT describe'), for a stem whose matched quote names ANOTHER choice, for an entry named by two symbols (Fcr and Fe), and for a capital G (gage vs shear modulus) + Open word questions: the entry whose NAME is inside the question is printed as ANSWER even when a negation or split negative prefix stands in front of it ('dis advantages', 'un braced', 'in elastic', 'not ductile'), or when the question asks one item of a container entry, a symbol, a comparison, or a list
clusters.root_cause:
[mc-letter-guards] pipeline.js SOLVE.choicePick (l.3662-3710). Route 1 (symbol, MC_SYMBOL_RE / MC_SYMBOL_END_RE l.3653-3654) and route 2 (definition) have NO negation test. contentWords (l.~3720) drops 'not' as a CHOICE_STOP word, so route 2 matches her positive sentence. wordsx choose() (l.691) does abstain on NEG_RE and on ties, but the merge at pipeline.js l.2028-2032 acts only when wordsx GIVES a letter, so the abstention never clears cur9.mc.best (242, 243, 244, 236). Route 2 circles the choice that fits the best entry's NAME even when that entry's quote names another choice as the thing described: PL quote -> 'modulus of elasticity' (245), 'Crushing vs buckling' -> 'elastic buckling' (237/230), 'Strain hardening' quote -> 'ultimate strength' (238; wordsx agrees, so no cross-check catches it), 'Plastic range' quote -> 'ductile' (228). Route 1 l.3677: 'last' = the last word of 'Critical stress Fcr and elastic buckling stress Fe', so a two-symbol entry counts as THE entry for Fe (246). The MULTI table (l.3685) has no G (gage / shear modulus), and the symbol match is case-sensitive, so 'G' in s^2/4G hits the shear modulus (161). With two choices, SOLVE.choiceCheck (l.3748, used at l.3805) prints 'Your choice: a' with no negation test (186).
[word-answer-guards] The frozen engine lookup_definition matches the longest entry name contained in the query (values.matched_by = 'name_in_query', values.matched_name = e.g. 'ductile', 'advantages of steel', 'stress strain curve'). pipeline.js wordAnswer (l.3552-3590) keeps it as ANSWER when wordsx agrees (l.3562 'eng === first', mode keep) or has it anywhere in its top 3 (l.3566, the 'two readers' rule). Nothing checks (A) the words right in front of the matched name: a negation 'not/non/no' (145, 162, 167) or a negative prefix typed apart 'dis ', 'dis-', 'un ', 'in ' (190, 119, 201, 191, 52, 08). wordsx rank (l.449-458) also ignores the 2-letter prefix in its order-free name subset, so its top agrees, and for 07 wordsx.top itself is 'Disadvantages of a braced frame'. Nothing checks (B) whether the entry answers what is asked: the container synonym 'stress strain curve' of the points-list entry swallows every 'what is the X called' curve question (115, 60, 202, 63, 61, 11); the frozen PL synonym 'slope of the straight line' wins a near-tie, 47.54 vs 47.14 (65); 'what does S / Lr stand for' gets the load-combination entry that does not name the symbol (198, 116); wordsx ranks G first with its whole synonym in the question but the 'two readers' rule keeps E (142); a 'difference between X and Y' gets one entry's top (wordsx analyze l.880, 199); 'list 3 reasons' keeps the one-liner while wordsx ranks the list entry first (219). With the prefix rejoined, the engine answers correctly: checked 'disadvantages of steel', 'unbraced frame advantages', 'disadvantages of a moment frame', 'disadvantages of an unbraced frame', 'list two disadvantages of a braced frame'.
clusters.fix_plan:
[mc-letter-guards] pipeline.js small local hunks inside choicePick / choiceCheck. If the local builder is busy in pipeline.js, put them in a NEW file loaded after pipeline.js that wraps SOLVE.choicePick / SOLVE.choiceCheck (both are called through SOLVE). (1) Negation: route 1 gives no letter when the stem has not|false|incorrect|untrue|except|never|n't|isnt|doesnt (wordsx NEG_RE). Route 2 gives no letter when the stem has a negation word that the best entry's quotes do not also contain, because the route cannot see polarity. choiceCheck returns null on the same test (186). The existing 'NO LETTER FROM THE PAGE' line then prints. No inversion: never turn her sentence round. (2) Route 2: no letter when ANOTHER choice's content words (stemmed, all of them) appear in the best entry's quotes (245, 237, 230, 238, 228). (3) Route 1: skip an entry whose name, without brackets, holds ' and ' / ' vs ' / two symbol tokens (246). Add G: ['gage', 'shear modulus'] to MULTI (161). The existing mm > 1 rule then gives no letter. (4) Optional: at the l.2028 merge, a wordsx abstention whose noLetterWhy is the NOT/EXCEPT reason clears cur9.mc.best (belt and braces for (1)). Every case here becomes NO LETTER (zero wrong). Coverage of positive MCs is untouched. MUST NOT CHANGE: C-48 (multiple choice with word choices stays a word question), 'in which E is' with one modulus choice, symbol picks of single-symbol entries, positive definition picks whose quote names no other choice. A route-2 stem with 'without' / 'not' inside her own quote keeps its letter only when the quote has the same word. Run regress.sh and read every CIRCLE that disappears; a lost letter is acceptable, a new one is not.
[word-answer-guards] A small helper in wordsx.js or a NEW file, one hunk in wordAnswer, and the query rewrite in reader.js FILL.lookup_definition. (A1) Coverage: rejoin a split negative prefix ONLY when the joined word is one of hers: 'dis advantages' / 'dis-advantages' -> disadvantages, 'un braced' -> unbraced, 'un factored' -> unfactored, 'non sway' -> nonsway. Check with wordsx ownWord, never blindly: 'dis ign' (BC-090 = design) must not join. Apply it to the query in FILL.lookup_definition (l.2559) and to wordsx's query tokens. ANSWER with her Disadvantages / unbraced entries (190, 119, 201, 191, 07, 52). Do NOT rejoin 'in elastic', which has two readings. (A2) Guard in wordAnswer: when matched_by is 'name_in_query' and the 1-2 tokens before matched_name in the question are not|non|no|never|without|n't|isnt|arent or a lone dis|un|in|im|ir, give NO ANSWER. Print WARNING ('your words put NOT / a negative prefix in front of "<name>": her entry for it is the opposite; the page does not turn it round; if you meant one word, retype it') plus the existing 'HER SENTENCES ABOUT THIS -- the page does not choose' list (08, 145, 162, 167). (B) Asked-form guards in wordAnswer, each a demotion to the her-sentences list, never a new pick: (B1) the engine entry's definition is a ';'-list of 3+ items, and the question asks ONE thing ('is called', 'what is the (point|region|slope|area) ...', 'which point', 'what does ... represent'): 115, 60, 202, 63, 61, 11. (B2) a near tie: wordsx hits[1].score >= 0.97 x hits[0].score with a different entry (65). (B3) the 'two readers' rule (l.3566) keeps eng only when no OTHER entry's full name or synonym is in the question overlapping eng's matched name (142). (B4) 'what does X stand for / mean / represent' with a 1-3 letter symbol X: keep only an entry that names X as a symbol, else demote (198, 116). (B5) wordsx analyze: 'difference between A and B' / 'compare A and B' / 'A vs B' sets no top unless the entry's name holds both A and B (199). (B6) 'list|name|give N ...' with wordsx hits[0] a list entry different from eng: no keep (219). MUST NOT CHANGE: the mock 'why does the number of bolts in the line change the capacity?' (l.3566 keep, engine right, matcher third: (B3)/(B6) must not catch it), C-48, positive definitions ('a material that is brittle is called' -> Brittle), 'what is the advantage of an unbraced frame', 'inelastic buckling ...' typed as one word, 'non-interior' in calculation parts (A2-loads-p125: word parts only). Run regress.sh and read every word-part change; demotions are acceptable, new ANSWER lines need a check against her store.

clusters.title: A NEGATED bracing phrase ('not braced against sidesway', 'not a braced frame', 'isnt braced against sway', 'the building has no bracing') is read as BRACED, and fixed-fixed / fixed-pinned keep the braced K (0.65 / 0.8)
clusters.root_cause: [k-sway-negation] reader.js maySway() (l.342-350). Its first .replace (l.344) deletes 'braced against (side)sway' from inside 'not braced against sidesway' and leaves a bare 'not'. So the final test's /\bnot\s+braced\s+against\b/ (l.349) can never match. The same happens to 'not a braced frame' (l.348 removes 'braced frame') and to 'isnt braced against sway'. 'no bracing' (the building / frame has no bracing) is not a sway phrase at all. maySway returns false, so findEnds l.463-464 keeps fixed-fixed (K 0.65, also printed through column_capacity: 1100 kips where 929 is right) or fixed-pinned (K 0.8). I re-ran all six on branch cloud: they reproduce. The corpus has the same misses (k04, k16, k24, k25, k26, k28, z07, z15, A2-noise-60). A bare 'not braced' with no 'against' (k03, k11 'fixed at the base and pinned at the top, not braced') also prints 0.8 clean.
clusters.fix_plan: [k-sway-negation] reader.js only, inside maySway plus one line in findEnds. (1) At the TOP of maySway, before any .replace, return true when the RAW text has a negated sway-bracing phrase: /\b(?:not|never|isn'?t|is\s*nt|aren'?t|wasn'?t)\s+(?:a\s+|an\s+)?braced\s+(?:against\s+(?:side[\s-]?)?sway|against\s+(?:lateral\s+)?translation|frame)\b|\b(?:frame|building|structure)\s+(?:is\s+not|isn'?t|is\s*nt)\s+braced\b|\b(?:frame|building|structure)\s+(?:has|have|with)\s+no\s+(?:lateral\s+|sway\s+)?bracing\b|\bno\s+bracing\s+against\s+(?:side[\s-]?)?sway\b/i. Write the comment with case A2-look-01 / k28. The existing l.463 rule then turns fixed-fixed into fixed-sway, so ANSWER K = 1.2 and column phi Pn = 929 (look-01/02/03/04/06). l.464 drops fixed-pinned, so look-05 ASKs the end conditions, which is right because 'pinned top free to sway' has two readings. (2) Optional, same file: a new swayUnclear(t) for a BARE 'not braced' / 'unbraced' / 'no bracing' NOT followed in its clause by at|about|along|in the (weak|strong|x|y)|mid|between|over|for|in either direction. In findEnds, a braced reading (pinned-pinned, fixed-fixed, fixed-pinned) with swayUnclear true becomes r = [], which is an ASK, never a conversion to 1.2 (k03/k11). MUST NOT CHANGE: 'braced against sidesway' (no negation), 'braced frame', 'non-sway', 'sidesway prevented', 'not braced at mid height', 'no bracing at mid-height', 'no bracing about the weak axis', 'not braced in either direction' (A1-ccap-24/54/55/101/103, A2-noise-14/15/121/141), 'unbraced length', and the noMove regex (l.422). Run harness/regress.sh and read every K / column change.
